caption: The video captures a dance studio where a central dancer, viewed from behind in a white long-sleeve top and black cropped pants, performs a port de bras. A full-width mirror wall topped by a tan panel fills the background, with a horizontal wooden barre and two black chairs at the left. At the first frame her arms are already extended outward and upward in a wide diagonal V. Throughout the clip they bend at the elbows, drawing the hands inward and overhead until the forearms form a closed curved frame with the hands crossed above her head. She then holds this overhead position with only small adjustments in the hand angle. The mirror reflects her front and several other dancers in white, pink, and black tops tracing the same trajectory in near synchrony, while partial figures at the far edges also keep their arms raised. Her lower body shifts from an early stance with one foot pointed and lifted to a later flat, turned-out placement. The room, barre, and chairs remain in place throughout.
